name: services/cards/student_card_data
description: Get data required to write new structure on ELS card
brief_description: Get data required to write new structure on ELS card

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector may contain any subset of fields, which are described in the returns section.

arguments.name: contact_chip_uid
arguments.description: Unique ID of integrated circuit card

arguments.name: contactless_chip_uid
arguments.description: Unique ID of contacless smart card

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
A dictionary of selected fields and their values.

Available fields:

  • certificate - Certificate in structure's signature;

  • system_key - Key used in structure's signature;

  • card_key - Key that allows write data on a card;

  • structure - Structure that is written or has to be written on a card;

  • expiration_date - Expiration date of a structure;

  • date_of_write - Date of write of a structure;

  • student_number - Student number printed on a card;

  • can_be_written - True if new structure may be written on a card;

  • card - Card object related.

    This field references objects returned by card method. See its returns section for possible subfields.
errors: • object_not_found - some of the referenced objects do not exist.

result_fields.name: card_key
result_fields.description: Key that allows write data on a card

result_fields.description: Structure that is written or has to be written on a card

result_fields.description: Date of write of a structure

result_fields.description: Student number printed on a card

result_fields.description: True if new structure may be written on a card
